text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: (Huh? Is that the ceiling?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Finally awake, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: McQueen? Are we in the infirmary?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I noticed you were particularly
absorbed in
your work as of late, but I
never thought
you'd actually collapse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the stress got to me more
than I
thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let's be grateful that it was just
fatigue.
Now... care to tell me what
work was so
important that you ended up collapsing?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I just...
wanted to find a way to guarantee
Suzuka's success.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Her success?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Correct me if I'm wrong, but the Suzuka I
know is not cause for such
concern... Is
that truly the reason?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well, I do want to make sure she succeeds... But that's because I'm afraid of what happens if her body fails...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: All right, all right. The truth is...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: All right, all right. The truth is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The risk of Suzuka's running style...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
She runs amazingly—like a dream! Even I
get chills thinking about
what we'll see at
her next race.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But...
what if that running is doing harm to
her body? I'd hate to see
her future stolen
from her by an accident.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But...
what if that running is doing harm to
her body? I'd hate to see
her future stolen
from her by an accident.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But that's the worst-case scenario. You
seem so certain that this will
happen.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing anything that would
guarantee it, but... I can't find
anything
that would prevent it either.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing anything that would
guarantee it, but... I can't find
anything
that would prevent it either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, why don't we start by taking a
nice, deep breath?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I don't think such an unlikely
scenario is worth your concern.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Surely you've heard this before, no? We
Umamusume run carrying the
hopes and
dreams of others.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Agnes Tachyon mentioned the same
thing when I talked to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard you work for your
dreams, there comes a time when you feel
you cannot proceed any further.
Sometimes it's a physical problem, and
sometimes psychological.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I can't go on." "This is the end." I can't
tell you how often I've had
those thoughts...
I'm sure my teammates have all felt the
same.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, overcoming limitations is another
part of being an Umamusume. And by
doing so, we challenge the notion that
such
limitations existed in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As long as we have the hopes and dreams
of our supporters,
Umamusume are
limitless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you need proof, you needn't look any
further than your own
journey.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Wait, me?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Wait, me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When each of your trainees fell on hard
times, who was it that picked them up? As
we took off towards our dreams, who
pointed us towards
the finish line?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for you and the
unconditional
support you offered us,
none of us would
be who we are today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I would say you've helped us
achieve more than we could
have ever
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To think that you would dedicate
everything, just for me... I am truly

grateful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But despite that,
I will shoulder your hopes
and keep running—as your
team's ace!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I want to win too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And I want to make them smile today. So
I'm going to give this race
my all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna win! It's always been my dream!
I'm
scared, but I can't quit
now!
URAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Totally! And we'll run them all together!
Let's go for it! To what's
beyond the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
With all this support, I refuse to yield.
Victory is mine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I'm not going to stop here. My
urge to run is what I'll use to
propel me
forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even if your path with Suzuka does hit her
limit, it will be all right. I'm
sure you'll find
a way forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of all the hopes and dreams propelling her
forward, I'm sure yours are
some of the
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when the way forward was blocked,
McQueen and the others all
managed to
break through and make their dreams
come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's because I was there to offer
them a final push as they tore
down those
barriers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's because I was there to offer
them a final push as they tore
down those
barriers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then I shouldn't be
sitting around making Suzuka
anxious.
Instead...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then I shouldn't be
sitting around making Suzuka
anxious.
Instead...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She should be running on the training
track. I suggest you go give her
the same
push you gave us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka believed in me enough to
join our team. Since then, we've been on
this path together, racing towards the
scenery of her
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka believed in me enough to
join our team. Since then, we've been on
this path together, racing towards the
scenery of her
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But somewhere along the line, my eyes
wandered... I started to worry
about her
ability to run—about things that had not
yet happened.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But somewhere along the line, my eyes
wandered... I started to worry
about her
ability to run—about things that had not
yet happened.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Suzuka, I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Suzuka, I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I've been teaching you all about running
techniques and different training methods,
but I forgot the most important lesson I
can give
you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I've been teaching you all about running
techniques and different training methods,
but I forgot the most important lesson I
can give
you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And what would... that be?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Every time I watch you run, I can see you
coming into your own as a
racer. And every
time, my heart swells with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Every time I watch you run, I can see you
coming into your own as a
racer. And every
time, my heart swells with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But so do my fears. I worry that your body
won't be able to handle the
strain.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But so do my fears. I worry that your body
won't be able to handle the
strain.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And over time, I let those fears grow
bigger and bigger, to the point
where I
obsessed over a made-up scenario.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And over time, I let those fears grow
bigger and bigger, to the point
where I
obsessed over a made-up scenario.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see,
so that's why you looked so anxious.
You were concerned for
my well-being...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but now I realize that those worries
are proof that I didn't trust
you enough. I
didn't believe you could keep running.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but now I realize that those worries
are proof that I didn't trust
you enough. I
didn't believe you could keep running.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka... No matter how long or short our
journey may be, I want to
be there for you.
I want to see you catch up to that scenery
you seek, just like we promised!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka... No matter how long or short our
journey may be, I want to
be there for you.
I want to see you catch up to that scenery
you seek, just like we promised!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
In order to make that happen, all I can
do—and all I need to do—is
believe in you!
So please...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
In order to make that happen, all I can
do—and all I need to do—is
believe in you!
So please...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All right,
I won't let anything hold me back
anymore. I'll leave all my
rivals behind and
take hold of my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And I know you'll be there, cheering me
on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With those simple words, the heavy cloud
that was hanging over my
head dissipates,
replaced by a giddy, slightly embarrassed
smile.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Could you make one more promise to me?
After you leave the pack
behind and cross
the finish line...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Could you make one more promise to me?
After you leave the pack
behind and cross
the finish line...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
How else will I return the hopes
you entrusted me with?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I promise, I will always come back.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're leaving the final corner and heading
into the homestretch! In
the lead is Silence
Suzuka! But the other racers are in fast
pursuit!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
From the outside comes Air Groove! Air
Groove is closing the gap!
Closer, closer...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But it's no use! It's Silence Suzuka!
Silence
Suzuka maintains her lead
with another
burst of speed!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka... is our winner! With that
breakneck speed, she's
claimed the grand
prix title!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume run carrying the hopes and
dreams of others, including
mine...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never felt those words ring truer
than
at today's race.
